speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you have knee pain after increasing your physical activity; to help me determine the cause, please tell me exactly where the pain is located and how it started. Are you currently able to bear weight on that leg?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old female. The patient presents with knee pain that started yesterday and has been steadily worsening. She cites recent participation in volleyball involving repetitive pivoting and twisting movements as a possible cause. She was advised at her last physical exam that weight loss could be beneficial for her health.

speaker: Doctor
text:

Given the worsening pain, have you experienced a "pop" when it started, or does the knee feel unstable or give way? Can you perform a full range of motion without sharp pain?
